line: push    offset aYouWillGain10I; Initializes Oblivion UI string setting sSpecialization. Its help text says '+10', but it is presentation data only; TESNPC_RecalculateAutoStats authoritatively executes a +5 specialization contribution at level 1 (plus 0.5*(level-1)).

call    GameSetting_ConstrAndReg; Verified GameSetting_ConstrAndReg stores setting value/default at object +0 and name key at +4, rejects duplicate names through g_GameSettingsByName, and inserts the key-to-setting mapping.
